research_name: RESIDUAL NEIGHBOR EFFECT / ADJACENCY AXIS CLOSURE V2
research_purpose: Preserve EXP-018 V1 and clarify only the deterministic percentile target-round cluster bootstrap construction for U95_DELTA before any outcome access.
hypothesis: Within target and exact Return-age strata, Neighbor status has positive practically relevant residual association with T MAIN6 inclusion.
counter_hypothesis: Within fixed target and exact Return-age margins, Neighbor status provides no additional positive information.

calculation_method.primary: unchanged exact DP convolution of conditional Hypergeometric distributions
calculation_method.rng: Python random.Random independently initialized per split
calculation_method.sampling: ascending matched-round population with replacement via rng.randrange
calculation_method.u95: sort ascending and select zero-based index 94999 without interpolation

failure_criteria: both splits U95_DELTA < 0.0100 closes only the locked ±1 axis
one split positive only gives FAILED_NOT_REPRODUCED
any invalid bootstrap replicate blocks execution

future_data_block.rule: target T predictors use MAIN6 only through T-1

multiple_testing_risk.control: one formal question; all subgroups exploratory only

overfitting_risk.control: V1 rules preserved; percentile order statistic and RNG fixed before outcomes
